subject: How to run SVDquartets for individual samples rather than species/populations

messages.author: 5fc34a138d2dc378
messages.subject: How to run SVDquartets for individual samples rather than species/populations
parts:
Hi Arthur,

I am wanting to estimate a phylogeny using the SVDquartets method, but I have hit a snag where the nexus file I generate using DartR instructs PAUP to construct the tree based on my populations/OTUs that I defined in my genlight object, rather than based on all the individual samples. I can't seem to work out how to construct the tree for all my individual samples, so I was hoping that you could help me to do that. Is there a command I can use to build a 'inds' tree rather than a 'pops' tree? Thanks very much for your time.

Regards,
James

messages.author: a3ea45e87285d820
messages.subject: Re: How to run SVDquartets for individual samples rather than species/populations
parts:
Hi James,

This should work

pop(gl) <- indNames(gl)

then run the gl2svd script.

A

messages.author: 5fc34a138d2dc378
messages.subject: Re: How to run SVDquartets for individual samples rather than species/populations
parts:
Thanks very much- that did the trick!

James
